title: lane r1: fourth lane outside the classification universe; no receipt-moment analog
description: Lane round 1. Lenses: SE (F4) + methodology (F1) merged (validators: SO). Owner: SO session. Defect: Directive reconciliation enumerates three classifications; the symmetric bullet routes fixes to an unenumerated fourth ('increments'); a self-originated fix has no operator utterance, so 'exactly as operator directives' has no statement-target — a cold agent force-fits recorded-override, which authorizes execute-then-record, inverting before-implementation. Citations verified: contract:46, :48, :51. Proposed: resolved-candidate — enumerate the increment lanes in the classification set and define the statement-target as the finding issue at filing.

comments.content: Fixed: classification universe extended with 'increment entry' (feature at 1a, or the fix lane); statement-target for self-originated work defined as the finding issue at filing (the receipt-moment analog), with the scope reading as the governed-set determination.
